written_before: any label of the fresh documents existed
gold_for_rules: strict (a category counts only when both annotators gave it); lenient is reported as a sensitivity check and decides nothing

domain_shift.question: Does the shipped model hold up on fresh real Terms of Service?
domain_shift.measure: macro-F1 on the fresh documents (strict), averaged over the categories that have at least one strict label
domain_shift.pass_if: fresh macro-F1 is no more than 0.15 below the validation honest macro-F1
domain_shift.if_fail: DOMAIN SHIFT: treat it as the main risk in Session 11

cue_margin.question: Should the possible cue use a 0.10 margin instead of 0.05?
cue_margin.measure: possible cues at margin 0.10 on the fresh documents (strict)
cue_margin.pass_if: they reach at least 20% of the missed labels AND add at most 5 per 100 sentences

zero_flag_marks.question: Should the Check it yourself panel show marks only for categories with no flag in the document?
zero_flag_marks.measure: worth-a-look marks kept only for categories with zero flags in that document (strict)
zero_flag_marks.pass_if: they reach at least 40% of the missed labels AND add at most 20 per 100 sentences (the Session 09 rule)
zero_flag_marks.if_pass: MAKE zero-flag-only the default in Session 11
zero_flag_marks.if_fail: KEEP showing all marks, off-by-default toggle stays
